text:
support_alex: FYI multiple customers started hitting 502/504 from hosted-inference in eu-west around 02:15 UTC. Ticket INC-4321 aggregated. p95 & p99 latency spiking too.

support_alex: example curl from customer: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/hosted/inf -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxx' -d '{"input":"hi"}'` -> `HTTP/1.1 502`

support_alex: Passing this to oncall because a small set of tokens are getting a ton of errors. Logs attached to the ticket.

eng_oncall_mira: Acknowledged. Investigating now. Can someone grab backend logs and the autoscaler events for the eu-west pool? Any recent deploys?

infra_jay: Seeing a pattern: several gpu-worker pods restarted between 02:16-02:18 with OOMKill on the kv-cache worker. sample log: ```2026-03-17T02:17:03Z worker-7 kubelet: container "kv-cache" OOMKilled: memory requested exceeded limit; rpc: backend unhealthy```

metricsbot: ALERT: eu-west hosted-inference p95 latency jumped from 220ms -> 2.6s at 02:15 UTC; error rate (5xx) rose from 0.2% -> 8.4% over 10m.

eng_oncall_mira: Good find. Looks like large batch + long sequence combos pushed memory. Any heavy clients identified?

sres_kyle: We have one token (token:tok_7Y) at ~350 RPS with large prompts and 64 batch size. Query to find culprit: `elk query: source:hosted logs | filter token:tok_7Y and status>=500 | stats count() by endpoint`

eng_oncall_mira: Quick mitigation suggestion: throttle that token at the gateway and enable model fallback for affected routes. Can we flip the per-token rate-limiter while we remediate?

infra_jay: I can patch a temporary policy to cap tok_7Y to 50 QPS on the gateway. Pushing policy now. Also bumping autoscaler min_replicas from 2 -> 4 for eu-west pool as an emergency.

deploybot: rollback completed: canary v2.15.3 -> v2.15.2 at 02:30 UTC (automated).

eng_oncall_mira: After rollback and token throttle, error rate dropped to ~1.1% but p95 still elevated. Need root cause: kv-cache memory growth when batch_size > 32 + long sequence lengths. Repro steps below.

eng_oncall_mira: REPRO (short):
1) Use token tok_7Y (or simulate high concurrency)
2) POST to /v1/hosted/inf with `max_new_tokens: 1024` and `batch_size: 64` and long prompt (~20k chars)
3) Observe backend worker memory climb and `kv-cache` OOM within 2-3 minutes

eng_oncall_mira: Repro logs snippet: ```[02:16:42] batcher: creating batch size=64 seq_avg=800 tokens -> scheduling to worker-7
[02:17:01] worker-7: kv-cache growth: rss 10.2G -> 15.6G -> OOMKilled```

sres_kyle: Actionable short-term fixes: reduce default max_batch_size to 32 for hosted, add per-route `max_request_tokens` guard, and enforce soft limits at gateway to reject monstrous prompts with 413-like response. Also add jittered retries for client SDKs to reduce simultaneous bursts.

cust_success_sam: We have several paying customers impacted. Can we draft a short customer-facing note: what happened, affected windows, mitigation steps taken, and ETA for full fix?

support_alex: Draft for customer update: "We experienced elevated 5xx errors and latency in eu-west between 02:15-02:35 UTC caused by a combination of high-concurrency requests with very large prompts which exhausted backend kv-cache memory. We rolled back a recent canary, throttled offending token(s), and scaled the autoscaler. Root cause investigation and long-term mitigations are in progress. Next update in 2 hours or when we have a patch." Thoughts?

cust_success_sam: Fine. Add note that no data loss and recommend customers reduce batch_size or contact support to request temporary rate-limits.

eng_oncall_mira: Assigning action items: 1) infra: make autoscaler min_replicas bump automatic when mem pressure detected (infra_jay) 2) runtime: enforce `max_batch_size=32` and add sequence-length checks (eng_oncall_mira) 3) platform: gateway soft-reject for >50k prompt chars and per-token throttling UI (sres_kyle) 4) docs + runbook update: add repro/playbook and customer comm template (support_alex/cust_success_sam) 5) postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC (all)

infra_jay: Started a PR for autoscaler trigger based on memory pressure, linking in ticket INC-4321.

eng_oncall_mira: I'll open the runtime PR to cap batch size and add a unit test for kv-cache growth.

sres_kyle: I'll add a quick dashboard and an alert that fires if any single token >200 RPS for >1m and error rate climbs >1% simultaneously.

support_alex: I'll send the customer note and update the ticket once message approved by cust_success.

cust_success_sam: Approved. Send now with outbound flag.

eng_oncall_mira: Postmortem owners: infra_jay (infrastructure), eng_oncall_mira (runtime), sres_kyle (alerts/runbook). Meeting invite sent for 2026-03-18 10:00 UTC.

support_alex: Thanks team. Follow-up items captured in INC-4321. Closing war room for now — monitoring for regressions. :thumbsup:
